change: Reduce the Memento range size from 4 MiB to 1 MiB while retaining the 260,000,000-byte ceiling and every scientific rule.
reason: One 4 MiB range completed, but the next connection closed three times before delivering the same 4 MiB interval. One MiB requests remain below both observed connection-close boundaries and do not change archive identity or analytic content.
accounting: Because failed Node processes cannot persist an exact count of response fragments already received, the final receipt must not report a falsely exact cross-process byte total. It reports the completing process's observed count and a conservative 260,000,000-byte upper bound. The completed file must still equal the 159,164,372-byte NIST object exactly.
notChanged: official NIST URL, byte count, SHA-256, and central-directory hash
all fingerprints, gates, rank rules, and implementation-independence requirements
prohibition on image acquisition and natural-position inference
scientificEffect: None; no local member header, compressed member, CSV row, feature, rank, or gate result had been inspected.
